mentions.name: GitnCoffee
mentions.description: A Git hosting service focused on performance and great UX, offering source code hosting and patch sharing with features like stacked diffs and automatically protected branches. Currently available as a cloud-hosted version, with plans to open-source most of it when more complete.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a new Git hosting service focused on performance and great UX. It's another take on source code hosting and patch sharing, with some nice features like stacked diffs, automatically protected branches.
